summary.text: Myriad army ant nest is Wu Shuai's battlefield killer move. Qi Sea Ancestor names it when Profound Literature grotto-heaven is trapped.

claims.text: Wu Shuai lands in Profound Literature grotto-heaven. Countless ants wrap around him layer upon layer and replenish as they are destroyed. He points, and army ants form the shape of a giant eagle that attacks the grotto-heaven. Army ants tear and gnaw. Endless gnawing sounds fill the place. Many areas are drilled through into tunnels. The grotto-heaven is already ruined, with ants roaming everywhere.

The aperture walls crumble and are replaced by huge dark brown earth walls filled with bumps and holes. Countless caves and passageways run through the walls, like a maze. Li Xiao Bai and Su Qi Han are bounced back in as they try to leave. Zhou Xiong Xin sees a battlefield killer move faster than rumor cage. Heavenly Court has not finished trapping Qi Sea Ancestor when they fall into a battlefield first.

Qi Sea Ancestor knows this is Wu Shuai’s myriad army ant nest battlefield killer move. Its core Immortal Gu is rank eight ant nest Immortal Gu. The move uses a blessed land or grotto-heaven as the base. Countless army ants are first sent to corrode that base. After the corrosion reaches a certain point, the battlefield activates. Once activated, it turns the crumbling blessed land or grotto-heaven into an ant nest battlefield. Activation is extremely fast. The prior accumulation takes a long time. Rumor cage remains the fastest battlefield killer move by that comparison.

After Wu Shuai activates myriad army ant nest, every existence in Profound Literature grotto-heaven is trapped. He sends army ants to attack Gu Immortals and to devour resources and breed. Heavenly Court Gu Immortals, seeing army ants work in tandem with the battlefield, realize Wu Shuai is the user. Finding a person in an ant nest battlefield as large as Profound Literature grotto-heaven is not easy. Wu Shuai hides in a corner and mobilizes ants through countless tunnels.

Densely packed army ants climb Seven Fiendish Primeval Monarch, and that giant breaks apart. Later, the star array calculation formation collapses. Remaining stars self-detonate. Under Star Constellation Chessboard, that power breaks the ant nest battlefield, reduces four Heavenly Court immortals into powder, and seals Qi Sea Ancestor.
